No front door

Followers stay followers

A woman can read your captions for months, feel completely seen, and still never join an email list. That trust doesn't turn into anything you can follow up on.

No qualifier

Calls start from zero

"Book a call" asks for a big step from someone who may have found you yesterday. Some aren't ready, some can't invest yet, and you only learn that once you're on the call.

Two businesses

Your time is split

You're coaching, organizing and creating content. Every hour on a call with the wrong person is an hour taken from clients, your family or yourself.

The women who love your content but aren't ready for coaching today have no clear next step, so most of them take none.

My recommendation

A $17 masterclass that pays for its own ads and fills your coaching calendar

You don't have a low-ticket product yet, so the class itself becomes one. Static 3 · Contrast layout · Hook: the "should" way vs the low-demand way

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"The planner graveyard"

Hook
"Every late-diagnosed AuDHD woman I work with has a drawer full of planners she used for one week." (to camera, opening a drawer of planners)
Body
"It's not a discipline problem. Most systems are built for brains that run on routine and delayed rewards. When the system doesn't fit the brain, it fails, and the woman blames herself. As a pro organizer and AuDHD coach, I build it the other way round." (simple on-screen captions)
CTA
"I teach exactly how in a 90-minute masterclass called The Unmasked Home. It's $17. Tap Sign up to get your seat."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"The minimum version"

Hook
"This one idea changed how my clients run their homes: the minimum version." (Esmeralda in a tidy corner of a room)
Body
"Every routine gets two versions. The full one for good days, and a two-minute one for low-energy days. Dishes become 'clear the sink.' Laundry becomes 'one load in.' Something still counts, so the routine survives the hard weeks." (caption for each example)
CTA
"I walk through the whole approach in my $17 masterclass. Link below. Educational content, not medical advice."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Why I'm a coach and an organizer"

Hook
"People ask why I'm both an AuDHD coach and a professional organizer. Here's the honest answer." (walking, natural light)
Body
"Because for so many women diagnosed later in life, the inside and the outside are connected. Masking all day leaves nothing left for the house. And a house that fights you makes it harder to stop masking. So I work on both."
CTA
"I put it all into one 90-minute class called The Unmasked Home. It's $17, and there's a replay if you can't make it live. Tap Sign up."
